messages:
priya: heads-up — on prod just noticed a user granted 'viewer' via admin API still sees the Edit button on Project page. audit shows role assignment at 2026-03-20T03:12:01Z but UI permission eval returns editor. @jenna can you help triage? :eyes:

jenna: hmm, odd. can you paste quick repro steps and any request/response you saw?

priya: repro steps:
1) curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/admin/assign-role -d '{\"user_id\":\"u-123\",\"role\":\"viewer\",\"project_id\":\"p-987\"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
2) response 200, admin audit entry present: audit.user.role_change user=u-123 role=viewer project=p-987
3) login as u-123 -> visit /projects/p-987 -> Edit button visible in UI

curl snippet:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/admin/assign-role \
  -d '{\"user_id\":\"u-123\",\"role\":\"viewer\",\"project_id\":\"p-987\"}'
```

Also ran the ui-perms endpoint manually and got `{\"can_edit\": true}` around 03:12:03Z.

infra-bot: deploybot: scheduled deploy cand-2026.03.20-04:00 (note: recent infra deploy 03:00 with KMS key rotation)

oliver: +1 to cache propagation as first suspect. `project_perms` cache is keyed by `project:{id}:user:{id}` and TTL is 5m. If admin-api emits an async webhook to the permissions worker but the SPA hits ui-perms before webhook finishes, you'll see stale perms. Another angle: last night's KMS alias rotation may have removed the grant for `svc/role-eval`, so the role-eval service might be failing to decrypt encrypted role blobs and falling back to a permissive default. Check KMS Decrypt logs for `role-eval` service account.

david: also confirm whether the UI uses client-side JWT claims (set at sign-in) versus server-side permission check. SPA cached claims won't reflect a role change until re-auth. SSR/page-level checks call ui-perms. Different codepaths could explain why some pages show Edit and others don't.

priya: quick log snippets: 
`2026-03-20T03:12:01Z audit.user.role_change user=u-123 role=viewer project=p-987 actor=u-admin`
I don't see any `audit.permission_eval` or `audit.cache.invalidate` log lines for u-123 at that time. The ui-perms service returned `can_edit: true` at 03:12:03Z and there's no KMS Decrypt entry for role-eval around 03:11-03:13Z.

jenna: i'll take ownership of a hotfix. proposed plan:
- immediate: add synchronous cache invalidation in admin-api's role assignment path (invalidate `project_perms:{project}:{user}` before returning)
- mid: add an audit event `permission_eval` each time ui-perms is invoked (rate-limited) so we can trace evals linked to role changes
- test: unit + e2e covering SPA (JWT refresh) and SSR ui-perms path
- rollout: staging -> canary 10% (60m) -> full; feature flag `rbac-ui-cache-safety` default ON, revertible
assigning to @jenna, will open PR and run canary.

sec-oncall: additionally, please check KMS IAM grants. I don't see `kms:Decrypt` entries for `svc/role-eval@redwood` in the last 24h, which suggests the grant may have been removed during alias rotation. If role-eval cannot decrypt role blobs it should fail closed (deny) — falling back to allow would be a bug. We should audit KMS key policy and run a short backfill to re-evaluate cached perms if grants were briefly missing.

priya: thanks — i'll gather more logs and open a runbook with steps to repro + quick mitigation (force re-eval on assignment). attaching exact request/response and the ui-perms trace id (trace: 9f3a4c).

infra-bot: deploy scheduled for canary at 2026-03-20T04:00Z :thumbsup:

jenna: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1428 — adds sync invalidation + permission_eval audit event + test matrix. I'll kick off staging tests now and monitor `console.perm_mismatch_rate` and audit log counts. If anything spikes, revert flag `rbac-ui-cache-safety=false`.

david: I'll run the runtime smoke tests against canary and verify audit entries show both role_change and subsequent permission_eval within 10s. Will report back in this thread.

priya: thanks everyone. leaving initial triage notes in the incident board and will ping once we have canary results. :white_check_mark:
